extract_answer: extract the final answer from a model response string using answer prefix patterns
strip_latex: strip latex formatting including boxed text and dollar signs from a response string
fuzzy_match: fuzzy match a prediction against a reference answer handling parentheses numbers and quotes
preprocess_sample: preprocess a model sample response by extracting lowercasing and cleaning the answer text
evaluate_correctness: evaluate whether a model sample response matches a reference answer using fuzzy matching
